test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 09 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a capital expenditure?

options.text: Loans and advances by the central government
Expenditure on the acquisition of land

solution:
The correct answer is __**Subsidies payment**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A** subsidy** is a **benefit provided** to a person, company, or institution, typically **by the government**.
 
• It can be either **direct subsidies (like cash payments) or indirect subsidies (such as tax breaks)**.
 
• A **government payment made directly or indirectly** to people or businesses is known as a **subsidy**.
 
• According to **economic theory**, subsidies can be **used to counteract market failures and boost economic efficiency**.
 
• **Loans and advances** by the central government, **expenditures on the acquisition of land**, and **investment in shares** are all **capital expenditures**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Government capital expenditures** are **funds used to develop buildings, machinery, equipment, educational and healthcare facilities**, etc.
 
• It **covers the costs incurred by the government** to **make investments** that will yield earnings or dividends in the future and to **acquire fixed assets** like land. **Repaying a debt is a capital expenditure **because it **reduces obligation** in addition to **creating assets**.
 
• By **enhancing production facilities and increasing operational effectiveness**, capital expenditures that result in the formation of assets are **long-term** in nature and **enable the economy to create income for many years**.
 
• Additionally, it **raises labour force participation, assesses the state of the economy, **and **increases its potential for future growth**.
